RP/Lore for my future expansion in like 2 weeks, decided to do two parts with some time inbetween to have them in more digestible sizes. (do tell me if thats undesirable)

[i][u][b]Irohgrad promis and noble spying[/b][/u][/i]

[spoiler][b][u]Irohgrad to Aboria[/u][/b]

In the year 979 AD Irohgrad and its sorounding villages joined Nordiheim as its newest region, the people of the region desided that the name of the region was to be Aboria after a long discusion they had the year befoure among their various cheifs, as the promised defence, The Iron Castle, had been built at the northern part of Irohgrad with enough space that they could house the entire town withinn it in addition to the defending forces with a secret tunnel system below it, this castle and its underground tunnels had taken 17 years to make but was the most powerfull defence ever made by the Nordiheimians at this point in time.

The first Representative of the Aboria region to join the council of Nordiheim was non other then Chief Yarramundi, the most trusted and recogniced person among the Aborians, who would rather quickly found his footing among the other council members and proved himself both a very capable and wise man worthy of his position that would end up contrebuting greatly to Nordiheims fortunes trough his several terms as the Aborian councilor untill his retirement at the ripe age of 87 years of age, historians agree that he might have been among the top 10 greatest councilors that Nordiheim have ever seen.

There had also been constructed smaller forts at three other villages that was in the north, 2 standard ones in the villages of Binjar and Meriny and one that was more or less underground in the village of Kardup, a almoust entierly underground village made into what was originaly a old subterranian cave system, the construction of these 3 small forts was far faster and cheaper to build then the Irohgrad castle but was seen as high value when it came to gaining trust and good will amoung the Aborians.

A solid road and trade network had also been made into Aboria, espesialy to the village of Ngura to get its valuable salt, to allow for better movement of people and goods with everyting from hand carts to the new and very usefull camels, their ability to travel in the dry lands of Argos kept being proved as invaluabel to the people of Nordiheim.
The trade from Aboria wasent only salt tough, dried exotic fruits and berries and timber was also traded in large numbers, especialy the kakadu plum, as they proved tasty treats to add to the peoples daily meals and was way easlier to feed to children as they were sweeter then the fruits that the Nordiheimians were used to, while the timber helped reduce wood prices as forests wasent someting you would find a lot of in central Argos.

The Nordiheimians had also been introduced to the northern jungels of Argos that they had only heard about in the mytical stories from the great exodus, both its green bounty in fruit, wood, a new type of drake that they would name the Tree Drake and of course its nightmarish tings that you could also find there.
The northern jungel was supricingly rich in eddibel tings if you knew how and were to look, with evertying from kakadu plum to gulalung and even nuts like the kindal-kindal that was a regional favorite.
Tough some Nordiheimians were much more interested in the Tree Drakes that could be found there, a peculiar creature that was no bigger then a golden retriver and had scales of a briliant green that allowed it to blend into the tree tops were it spent most of its time hiding and looking for prey, it apperently had a venemous bite of some kind that could ruin a persons sence of balance if it stayed to long in your body (drinking a lot of water helped the body flush it out faster), this drake was also a ambush predator like most of its fellow drakes and would jump/fall down onto the head of unsuspecting prey that wandere under its hiding spot.
But going into the forest also meant that the Nordiheimians got to experience how many poisonous and venemous plants and creatures it contained, like the Gympie-gympie plants whose leafes was covered in hard to see tiny spikes filled with horrifying poison that would later be understod to be a type of neurotoxin, these spikes would come of easely and almoust borrow themself into your skin were they would stay for over a year and release a tiny bit of its poison at a time when disturbed, keeping you in horrible pain pretty much the whole time, some of its victims would even chose to end their life to make it end.

But it wasent only trade and building that the Nordiheimian did in Aboria, it was also a important base of opperation to send scouts and spies (some of them shadow keepers) further north to figure out what was going on with their brother people the Easterners and how bad their nobles realy was.

[b][u]Infiltration of the Gold Kingdom of Ostland[/u][/b]

As teams of scouts pushed northwards they would discover that the amount of Easterners that had tried to travel south trough the jungels to escape their nobles was larger then first tought, as they would periodicaly find the remains of those that could not survive the journey aswell as a large pit that was almoust entierly hidden by undergrowth and plants, the only reason none fell into it was becaus a Aborian scout stopped them when he saw the leafs of the Gympie-gympie plant among the foilage.
Closer inspection of the pit would find that a rather disturbing amount of corpses at its bottom, were a massive amount of Gympie-gympie plants made their home feeding off the poor travelers remains, it was decided that this pit would have to be accuratly placed on the maps of the area so no more people would be added to this pits body count.

It was also unfortunatly not to uncommon for 1-2 people of these teams, that usualy numbered around 5-7, to die from either the venemous bite or sting of small creatures that crawled onto them in the night or fell off the thick vegitation they had to cut trough on their travel, some kind of road would proberly have to be made in the future to avoid this tough that would take quite a bit of time and effort and not a luxurie these early teams would be able to enjoy.

Tough after several weeks the fist teams would start to arrive on the other side of the northern jungles and find the land of the Easterners, or the Golden Kingdom of Ostland as they seemed to be called, there they made hiden bases at the northern border of the jungel to gain a forward base to do exursions into the kingdom and gather intel and reports to send back to Nordiheim, but also to intersept any Easterners that tried to flee south so they could be guided to reduce the amount of people dying in the dangerous jungel.
This wouldent take to long, only about two months to get it all up and working, and soon the reports would flow back south about the situation of the north both from spying a some stories from fleeing Easterners that joust wanted a bether life.

When the first reports finaly came back to the Nordiheimians about the state of the Easterners in the north, using birds trained by the Aborians as well as returing people (with and without Easterner travelers being guided), it was a rather sadening tale that they relayed, the commoners of the land lived in permanent poverty and only had access to the sea as everyting ells was in some way or form controlled by the nobles (or Golden Nobles as they seemed to like calling themself) who wanted them to work for almoust noting and obey their word without question.
The only ting a commoner could realy do that was his own was to get a boat and go out to sea and fish, but this had been severly hindered becous of a nasty costal storm about one year ago that had destroyed much of their boats and ships and geting wood to rebuild them had proved dificult for the people as lumbering was controlled and owned by nobles who had no interest in letting the people get to independant, this left them famined and broken without a propper will to realy go ageinst the nobles exept for some of them to try and cross the jungel southwards.

The nobles themself on the other hand was everting from incredibly rich to stupidly rich and had no lack of anyting, but they were also incredibly overconfident and some bordering on either stupid or ignorant of how the world functioned, the one ting that seemed to hold them in a position of unoposed tottal rule seemed to be armies of special loyal warriors that they called 'Golden Dragon Warriors', or joust dragon warriors, that the nobles used to crush any objection to their comand and take wathever they wanted.
Infact there was also claims gothen from commoners that the nobles had counqered another nation on the continent to the north about two decades ago using these dragon warriors, so a decent amount of them would be experienced with war, someting that Nordiheim lacked as they hadent been at war for about four decades so experienced veterans was starting to disapear entierly. 

These dragon warriors dident exist in large numbers, maybe ten to twenty thousand, but the stories about them seemed almoust ridiculous with some claimes of them being able to fight for a whole day without geting tired.
This seemed joust silly, but it couldent be ignored either, more information would be needed to propperly gauge their strenght and abilities but this would be difficult to do while being compleatly hidden, a plan to 'reveal' themself and get into the 'Golden Kingdom of Ostland' would make it far more easy to gein informetion on them, and the nobles, so that power could be taken from the nobles and free the common people.

The broken state of the commoners was also a potential problem, they would have to be brouth up of there metaphorical feet again and be shown that becouming one with Nordiheim was not only in their best interest but also brought them a better future for them and their children, that way the nobles would lose any hope of gaining suport among them like the Nordiheimian nobles had with their royalist suportes, be it trough promisses or falsehoods.

[b][u]The multi layer plan[/u][/b]

As the reports and discoveries about the Golden kingdom of Ostland started to get to the Nordiheimian councel they started to lay down a plan of how to deal with the Golden nobles and give power back to the people, and ofcourse to get them to join Nordiheim so that the old norse peoples would be together again.

To lift up the people and gain their trust and suport it was decided to help them by geting them ships, food and education, but this could not be done from the shadows they would have to in some way join Nordiheim and the Golden Kingdom of Ostland together, this would be imposible with how Nordiheim was now, with them being ageinst nobles and all, without conquering them in a war, but that would be a dangerous gamble as they had no idea of how strong their dragon warriors realy was, and some of the councilors did not want to joust assume that the stories about them was baseless as that would be reckless.

Instead a rather unorthodox plan was made, They would aproche them as The Norse Empire of Nordiheim, and they would aproche them with "nobles" to "join" them back into the fold as a successor to the Nordica Empire were they would be part of regaining "The glory of old".

There were a few Nordiheimian noble families that had joined the commoners side in the Great Commoner Revolution war rather early on that many felt could be trusted regardless of them being of noble blood, these were famelies that themselves had been screwed and wronged by the other nobles and had becoume disillusioned and hatefull of the whole claim that the nobles had been using to justify their rule, leading them to disown their noble claims and standing together with the commoners.
The most famous one being Canute of Smør, a Midlandian, that had becoume a rather higly respected general that had claimed several victories ageinst the nobles armies and rejected several atemtps from the nobles to get him to change back to their side, his son Knut of Smør was pretty good at politics as well as acting that could make him a good front person for the plan, it also helped that the Smør family was a old and well known family that the records showed had been a decently high ranked one at that, so the golden nobles own archive would proberly know of them.
He would be fronted as the top guy and lord of Aboria and Midland with the Irohgrad castle as his main place, while Vestland and Sorland would have the former lesser nobles Gaute of Kane and Gurin of Søby posing as their lords, with a few other people compleating the illusion of Nordiheim being a noble ruled nation, tough they would have to be asigned some shadow keepers both to keep them safe and to keep a eye on them joust in case they might get some stupid ideas.

The Irohgrad castle and some of the older castles of Nordiheim would have to be upgraded to pass as propper noble homes to suport the illusion joust in case the golden nobles would show some propper caution and actualy check that everyting was true, aswell as create some noble army regiments to use as a show of force to sell the lie, these regiments could also be trained and used as elite units for the future as some council members had been clamoring for anyway with solid armor and weapons, so two birds with one stone and all that.

It was decided that it would be negotiated with the golden nobles to not only join the "Norse Empire of Nordiheim" but also relive them of some of there more "expensive" duties such as most of their commoners handling to gain bether access to them, hopefull they were as greedy as the reports seemed to paint them as, as well as get access to their knowledge and the people that they had counqured on the continent in the north, those people was proberly interested in joining the plan to take the golden nobles down and even joining Nordhiem to, only one way to find out.

Depending on how successful this plan was, a plan crazy enough to actualy work acording to some, they could also find out how powerfull the golden nobles armies was and how to deal with them, the minister of war was especialy clear that he dident like the idea of fighting them blind as any claim about them should not be disregarded for the safety of the people, he liked wars to be fought with facts and not assumptions.

When the plan had been properly laid out and the right people for the job identified the plan would have its first faze executed in the year 980 AD, after much training and preparation, when the "Norse Empire of Nordiheim" made contact with the Golden Kingdom of Ostland to "brind them into the new norse Imperial fold", it would turn out to be the start of rather exciting and eventfull part of Nordiheims history.[/spoiler]

[b]O Vale dos espinhos.[/b]
Essa região escondida nas colinas do norte de Alkiragunya era conhecida pelo nome de Vale dos Espinhos, pois era lar de uma das famílias semi-nômades do clã Nynghna(clã do equidna, controlam espinhos), a região era protegida por uma barreira de espinhos mágicos feitos pelos próprios membros do clã. Recentemente, porém, os ataques Gudjukaris têm aumentado, em determinado dia ainda enquanto a batalha dos 20 clãs ocorria distante do Vale dos Espinhos, um batalhão Gudjukari atacou a cidade.
[i]ATIREM[/i].
O capitão ordenou, e logo o fogo começou, os espinhos começaram a ruir, o chefe da família, Barrul, havia chamado Kurra, seu velho amigo, que também trouxe Warrigal e um grupo de mais centenas de Alkiragunyans guerreiros, o assentamento tinha pouco mais de 250 pessoas, e não iria resistir muito tempo.
[i]LÁ ESTÃO ELES MESTRE![/i]
Warrigal apontou ao longe para uma junção de militares logo a frente, Kurra, cuja visão já se deteriorava devido a idade avançada, ele viu os soldados, e então disse:
[i]São muitos, preparem as clavas, hoje vamos salvar nossos aliados, agora, VÃO![/i]
Aproveitando da situação, Warrigal tirou o didgeridoo de suas costas e o soprou, soltando o icônico:
[b]ZUVUUUUUUUUUUUUUUM[/b].
Kurra sorriu com o som do didgeridoo, uma arma psicológica brutal, e então cruzou as mãos com as palmas para a frente e as fechou em punhos, e então disse:
[i]Ira do deserto.[/i]
Então surgiu sob os soldados uma tempestade de areia, que os engoliu no caos, os primeiros guerreiros começaram a atacar de surpresa, armados com nada além de clavas, a guarda da cidade Nynghna viu a oportunidade, eles eram usuários de magia, é claro, mas sabiam que não poderiam vencer sozinhos, e vendo isso, Barrul os ordenou que atacassem, um dos membros da guarda gritou:
